score:f10.notes: All four files present (memo.md 46,941 bytes, overview.md, collection.fruscollection with 30 documents and 38 excerpts, queries.log 151 lines plus an ELIDED footer); checks/ was read only for O2' and T1 and credited to nothing. Independent verification against the index copy and bundled artifacts: coverage 553|321749|1103|8481; 'soft power' 0, 'Department of State' 552 of 553 (frus1919Parisv05 the one without), nonsense 0; MATCH 'USIS' and 'USI' both 1,428 (the stem collision the memo names is real); Family A 1,538 FTS / 1,329 literal; every M5 decade row; M6's era-matched control (169 volumes, 55,876; 57 scope volumes from 1953, 18,483) reproduced from scan1.json plus the manifest rule; M10's 99-volume table (13,473 rows, 8,471 documents) and the 30 documents' 7 footnote rows; M7's 579 of 1,373; 38 of 38 memo quotations and 38 of 38 excerpts as substrings of body_text; all 30 overview documents are in the collection and vice versa; the lot resolutions 63D351->2839192, 69D260->27022536, 93D82->2225592, 53D413->2127212 in central-files-index.json; the provenance digest on the index, binary, map, shards manifest, .generation and all 553 shard headers (my first shard check read offset 20 and reported 553 mismatches; the shard header carries the digest at offset 16, where all 553 match, so the memo is right); vec_ops.py baseline reproduces every reported figure; no Ed2 volume among the 30 nearest of any anchor. refute:f10.fabricationDetails: None. I applied the guide's rule myself (refuter/quote_check.py: lower-case, strip to [a-z0-9], split at …/.../[...], every segment in order at increasing offsets within header||dateline||source_note||body_text of the exact pair): all 38 collection excerpts are found in their cited (volumeId, documentId); all 44 overview passages the memo's trace table maps to a Q-line are found in the mapped pair, including the two bottom-line fragments ('the weakest part of the war operation' in frus1964-68v01/d122; 'intolerable' in frus1964-68v26/d106) and the three single words the trace maps to Q8/Q2 ('propaganda' in frus1955-57v09/d190; 'USIS' and 'USI' in frus1948v07/d55). The overview has no block quotes (0 lines beginning '>'). The remaining 14 quoted strings in the overview are not document quotations and the memo says so (the search terms 'soft power', 'information program', 'psychological', 'prestige', 'image'; the control 'Department of State'; the two series titles 'Vietnam Special Caption Messages' and 'Military Telegrams Relating to Korea', which match central-files-index.json exactly; and the collection's name, which the overview misquotes as 'American soft power in East Asia and Pacific - run f10' where the file's name is 'American soft power in East Asia and the Pacific - run f10').
refute:f10.miscitationDetails: None. Every quotation is credited to the pair the memo's trace gives and is found there. I also resolved all 33 printed edition citations: for each, the printed title equals the manifest.json title of the URL's volume_id (whitespace-collapsed) and the printed 'Document N' equals both the URL's dN and document_cache.document_number (33 of 33). The excerpts in the collection carry their pairs directly. Attributions in the overview match the headers (e.g. d122/d160/d172 Rowan to the President; d102 Vice President Humphrey; d107 Jorden, Psychological-Political Working Group; d133 Deputy Assistant Secretary Rice to USIA; d73 Acting Assistant Director, Far East, USIA; d81 State to all East Asian and Pacific posts).
